episodes.title: Vandreklubben
episodes.label: text_PODCAST · 27 OCTOBER 2026 · IN DANISH
episodes.summary: text_Thomas and his wife Michelle talk about love, hiking and life after a total laryngectomy. From their first walking date to long-distance hikes and Mammutmarsch, the conversation explores finding new ways forward when the body sets different limits. Michelle also shares her perspective as a partner and close supporter.

episodes.title: Diagnoseklubben
episodes.label: text_PODCAST · 28 AUGUST 2026 · IN DANISH
episodes.summary: text_Thomas joins the Danish podcast Diagnoseklubben for an open conversation about life after a total laryngectomy: voice, breathing, everyday life and everything that begins when treatment ends.

episodes.title: Cancer Interviews
episodes.label: text_PODCAST · 13 NOVEMBER 2026 · IN ENGLISH
episodes.summary: text_In an English-language interview with Jim Foster, Thomas talks about his rare laryngeal sarcoma, total laryngectomy, life with a permanent neck stoma and voice prosthesis, and rebuilding everyday life and physical activity after cancer.
